# Fenrir CRM

Customer relationship management for IT service businesses. For sales and account managers tracking accounts, leads, opportunities and quotes.

Fenrir CRM is one of the [Fenrir apps](../README.md): it runs on its own, with its own dashboard, from this
repository with `FENRIR_APP=crm`. It is free, self-hosted and released under the Apache License 2.0, as-is and
without support.

## What it does

- Accounts and contacts
- Leads and opportunities through a sales pipeline with stages, values and owners
- Convert a won lead into a customer, with its contact and a starting agreement
- Product catalogue with cost, price and margin
- Quotes with one-off and monthly lines, print-ready output and statuses (draft, sent, accepted, declined)
- Custom fields, saved views, webhooks and an API for your other systems

## Quick start

1. Fork this repository (or copy it into a private repository) and clone **your** copy onto a Linux server.
2. Point a domain name such as `crm.yourcompany.com` at the server.
3. Run setup and choose this app:

   ```bash
   deploy/setup.sh --app crm
   ```

   Setup asks for your domain, an administrator email and your organisation's name, writes `deploy/.env` with fresh
   secrets, and can build and start the server.
4. Open `https://crm.yourcompany.com` and sign in with the email and the password setup printed.

The [full guide](GUIDE.md) covers every step in detail, first use, each page, configuration, updates, backups and
troubleshooting.

## The dashboard

| Menu | Page | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| Home | **Dashboard** | The app's headline numbers and a way into each of its pages. |
| Business | **CRM** | Accounts, contacts, leads and opportunities through your sales pipeline; convert a won lead into a customer. |
| Business | **Products & quotes** | A product catalogue with cost and margin, and quotes you can print or send. |
| Admin | **Settings** | Customers (tenants), users and roles, custom fields, region and holidays, webhooks, API credentials, approvals, the audit log and platform options. |

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Server | Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS on amd64 recommended), 2 vCPUs, 4 GB RAM plus 4 GB swap, 40 GB SSD. The server image is the same for every app, so the first build still compiles the agents once (it takes a while; later builds reuse it). |
| Software | Docker Engine with buildx and Docker Compose 2.24.4 or newer, Git, curl, OpenSSL, Bash, Python 3. |
| Network | A domain name (DNS A record) pointing at the server; TCP 80 and 443 open; SSH restricted to you. |
| Signing | Not needed: this app has no device agents. |

## Not in this app

Tickets, time, projects and billing (the **psa** app). Agreements created when a lead converts are kept, and the PSA uses them if you add it later. To add another app later, switch to `FENRIR_APP=complete` (see [the guide](GUIDE.md#adding-more-apps-later)); your data is kept.
